title: The Missing Alibi Again
author: M. M. Oyelaran
blurb: Freya Villalobos, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
